semiconductor_relevance: High — Ultraband Technologies specializes in designing advanced semiconductor solutions for 5G and power applications, making it a relevant player in the semiconductor industry.
summary: Ultraband Technologies is a fabless IC design house focused on developing high-frequency 5G wireless Monolithic Microwave Integrated Circuits (MMIC) and advanced power devices. Their expertise includes optimizing epitaxial structures and device layouts for applications in RF front-end modules and satellite communication systems.
capabilities: Design of 5G wireless MMICs and RF Frontend Modules
Development of high breakdown voltage D-mode and E-mode GaN power devices
Creation of customized Multiband & MultiOrbit Phased Array Antenna Systems

regional_presence.Taiwan: Ultraband Technologies is based in Taiwan, leveraging local semiconductor expertise and resources.
